description: config:recommended pulls in :ignoreModulesAndTests, whose ignorePaths include **/test/** and **/tests/**. Helm puts test hooks in templates/tests/ by convention and ships them inside the package, so that default hides a real, published dependency. This is the preset's list with those two entries dropped; ignorePaths is not mergeable, so it has to be restated in full.

helmv3.description: Subchart dependencies declared in any chart's Chart.yaml.

helm-values.description: Container images pinned in chart defaults. Scoped to the chart tree rather than a hand-kept list of files, so a chart added later is covered without a config change.

kubernetes.description: Images in the throwaway manifests ct install needs. .helmignore keeps them out of the packaged chart, but ct treats any change under charts/<name>/ as a chart change, so these bumps still need a chart version bump.

customManagers.description: Tools installed from release tarballs in workflows and composite actions (helm-docs, crane), which the github-actions manager only reads for `uses:` lines. Without this the pinned versions would silently rot. Scoped to all of .github, not just workflows, because the helm-docs pin lives in a composite action.

Images pinned inside chart templates, such as the client image the Helm test pod uses. helm-values only reads values.yaml, and a Go template is not a parseable manifest, so without this they rot inside the published package -- at consumers.

packageRules.description: Chart dependency and image bumps always need a chart version bump alongside them, which Renovate cannot do -- so no automerge here, ever. The pull request is the place that decision gets made.
prBodyNotes: :information_source: This update touches a chart, so it needs a chart `version:` bump that Renovate cannot make. The `renovate-chart-bump` workflow adds it and re-runs lint and install; until it has, `ct lint` fails here. What is left for the reviewer is whether the new version is right for the chart.

packageRules.description: Anything under a chart directory is a chart change as far as ct is concerned -- a template image because it ships inside the package, a ci/ fixture because ct's check-version-increment does not care that .helmignore excludes it.
